deals: select d.pc_0012_id as id, d.name, d.stage, coalesce(s.is_closed, false) as is_closed, coalesce(s.is_won, false) as is_won, d.amount, d.currency, d.amount_base, d.weighted_amount, d.pwin, d.close_date, d.product_category__label as category, d.customer_type__label as ctype, d.region, d.region__label as region_label, d.created_at, (select c.name from associations a join companies c on c.pc_0011_id = a.other_record_id where a.object = 'deals' and a.other_object = 'companies' and a.record_id = d.pc_0012_id order by c.name limit 1) as company from deals d left join property_options s on s.object_type_id = 'pc_0012' and s.property = 'stage' and s.api_value = d.stage where d.pipeline = 'defense'
stages: select api_value, label, is_closed, is_won from property_options where object_type_id = 'pc_0012' and property = 'stage' and record_status = 'active' and 'defense' = any(parent_values) order by display_order
regions: select api_value, label from property_options where object_type_id = 'pc_0012' and property = 'region' and record_status = 'active' order by display_order
contacts: select count(*) as total, count(*) filter (where customer_type = 'defense') as defense from contacts
partnerships: select status, status__label as label, count(*) as n from partnerships group by status, status__label order by n desc
quotes: select q.pc_0022_id as id, q.name, q.status, q.status__label as status_label, q.amount_base, q.created_at from quotes q where q.created_at >= now() - interval '12 months' order by q.created_at desc
invoices: select i.pc_0023_id as id, i.name, i.invoice_number, i.status, i.status__label as status_label, i.amount_base, i.due_date, i.created_at from invoices i where i.created_at >= now() - interval '12 months' order by i.created_at desc
base: select code from currencies where is_base
